en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> him<sup>asws</sup>
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, disliked the peeling of fruits.’”
